svg.title: Agentic Lean Math Assistant Map
svg.desc: Two-panel program map showing ALMA's governed research lifecycle and fail-closed adaptive autorun loop, where agents propose, execute, and independently review while deterministic controller gates alone advance retained truth state.

text.tspan: Agentic Lean Math Assistant routes model work through deterministic, replayable gates.
Models propose, execute, and review; the controller is in charge of state transitions, resource policy, evidence integrity, and target closure.

svg.text: A fixed project contract becomes a bounded campaign with retained evidence, then ends in a verified or explicitly unresolved outcome.

g.aria-label: Operator Contract to Sol Research and Portfolio Planning: freeze inputs after the manifest and project inputs parse; hashes and snapshots then become authoritative.
Sol Planning to Operator Source Checkpoint: publication research found a critical unavailable source under checkpoint policy.
Operator Source Checkpoint to Sol Planning: resume only when the operator supplies the source or explicitly records a waiver.
Sol Planning to Controller Plan and Policy Gate: emit plan JSON after retained research completes or research is skipped.
Controller Plan and Policy Gate to Sol Planning: bounded repair after malformed plan or policy violation.
Controller Plan and Policy Gate to Controller Campaign Runtime: approve the DAG only after every controller policy check passes.
Controller Campaign Runtime to Reasoning-Class Role Router: dispatch by reasoning class only when dependencies and invocation budgets permit.
Reasoning-Class Role Router to Controller Evidence and Truth Gates: retain handoffs and receipts; agent claims enter as evidence, never truth.
Controller Evidence and Truth Gates to Controller Campaign Runtime: retry, replan, or block under configured failure policy and hard bounds.
Controller Evidence and Truth Gates to Assessment and Autonomous Success Gate: forward an auditable retained gate record when the campaign is assessable.
Assessment and Autonomous Success Gate to Verified Outcome or Controlled Exit: route only after controller validation; a model-written solved claim is insufficient.

Verified Outcome or Controlled Exit to Sol Planning: create a successor contract only for an unresolved result with a valid optimizer directive, unchanged problem and success hash, remaining budgets, and operator selection or configured AFK timeout.
A1 Operator Contract

text.tspan: It sets exact targets and axiom rules.
It caps model, tool, and resource use.

g.aria-label: A2 Sol Research and Portfolio Planning

text.tspan: Proposes the plan but cannot approve it.

g.aria-label: A3 Operator Source Checkpoint

text.tspan: Pauses when a required source cannot be accessed.
The operator may supply it, explicitly waive it,
or stop; the decision remains durable after resume.

g.aria-label: A4 Controller Plan and Policy Gate

text.tspan: Checks the plan's schema and dependencies.
Admits only plans that satisfy policy.
Returns rejected plans for bounded repair.

g.aria-label: A5 Controller Campaign Runtime

text.tspan: Freezes inputs and schedules ready DAG stages.
Applies cgroup limits, retries, and task locks.

g.aria-label: A6 Reasoning-Class Role Router. Luna, Sol, Terra, and Astra may take over tasks done by lower agents; these routes are alternatives, not a sequence.
g.text: routes are alternatives, not a sequence

g.aria-label: A7 Controller Evidence and Truth Gates. Execution, evidence, and truth are separate retained bands.
g.text: Retains receipts, digests, and replay data.
Lean and semantic gates control target closure.

g.aria-label: A8 Assessment and Autonomous Success Gate

text.tspan: Sol reports outcomes and next-step analysis.
The controller rechecks evidence, build, exact types,
axioms, and verifiers before it confers success.

g.aria-label: A9 Verified Outcome or Controlled Exit

Agents propose and execute tasks, and conduct independent reviews of other agents' work, but never self-verify. The success of a process, how polished a report seems, and retained evidence are not automatically treated as proof. Lean verifies the derivation and its permitted axioms; semantic review confirms that the formal statement matches the intended claim.

text.tspan: Agents propose and execute tasks, and conduct independent reviews of other agents' work, but never self-verify.
The success of a process, how polished a report seems, and retained evidence are not automatically treated as proof.
Lean verifies the derivation and its permitted axioms; semantic review confirms that the formal statement matches the intended claim.

svg.text: PANEL B: AUTONOMOUS FAIL-CLOSED DECISION LOOP
Astra decides what to try next, Sol does the work, Terra checks the results independently, and the controller decides what progress is recorded.

g.aria-label: Living Contract and Operator Bounds to Astra Strategy Governor: select or review when no strategy is active, a soft review is due, or replacement is required.
Astra Strategy Governor to Controller Strategy Gate: submit one strict final strategy proposal marker from the read-only governor.
Controller Strategy Gate to Route or Terminal State: reject without invoking Sol when a proposal is malformed, stale, forbidden, unsupported, or beyond deadline.
Controller Strategy Gate to Sol Autorun Conductor: activate the contract only after policy and lineage validation.
Sol Autorun Conductor to Controller Execution Boundary: retain the exact active identity with Sol's claim and artifacts.
Controller Execution Boundary to Terra Independent Adjudicator: forward retained output and trusted metrics after process success; process success does not equal progress.
Controller Execution Boundary to Route or Terminal State: bounded recovery with backoff follows timeout, nonzero exit, or missing output; repeated failure triggers review, never Astra execution.
Terra Independent Adjudicator to Controller Transition Gate and Ledger: return exact strategy identity and earliest admissible checkpoint, or a valid not-applicable result.
Controller Transition Gate and Ledger to Route or Terminal State: accept and append only when strict parsing and aligned evidence validate; complete means the full Living Contract.
Controller Transition Gate and Ledger to Route or Terminal State: invalid, stale, or wrong-order adjudication fails closed; evidence remains retained but truth state receives no credit.
Route or Terminal State to Sol Autorun Conductor: continue only while the active contract remains valid, no review or stop is due, and the unchanged hard deadline remains.

Route or Terminal State to Astra Strategy Governor: govern when a soft review is due, or replace course after absent accepted progress, drift, falsification, or hard expiry; replacement creates a new lineage.
B1 Living Contract and Operator Bounds

text.tspan: Operator bounds fix lineage, resources, and stop.

g.aria-label: B2 Astra Strategy Governor

text.tspan: Chooses whether to continue or change course.
Sets soft reviews, checkpoints, and stop conditions.
Governs read-only; never executes or self-verifies.

g.aria-label: B3 Controller Strategy Gate

text.tspan: Requires strict JSON and exact strategy identity.
Checks current evidence and gate order.

g.aria-label: B4 Sol Autorun Conductor

text.tspan: Uses approved tools. This autorun is Sol-only.
Its final report is a claim with no state authority.

g.aria-label: B5 Controller Execution Boundary

text.tspan: Starts each request and monitors its heartbeat.
Enforces cgroup limits and the round deadline.
Retains receipts, trusted metrics, and output.
Uses bounded recovery after process failure.
Sandbox-off is explicit; cgroup limits remain.

g.aria-label: B6 Terra Independent Adjudicator

text.tspan: Reviews artifacts, code, and metrics without writes.
Reports only the earliest admissible checkpoint.
Claims completion only for the full Living Contract.

g.aria-label: B7 Controller Transition Gate

text.tspan: Checks identity, order, and completion semantics.
Only accepted Terra output may credit progress,
advance checkpoints, or complete the contract.

g.aria-label: B8 Route or Terminal State

Each agent has a separate role: Astra reviews strategy without editing, while Sol performs the autorun work. The project manifest defines success, and soft review gates never reset the original hard ceilings. Operator stop and resource controls, including cgroup limits, remain in force even when sandboxing is disabled. Failed runs enter bounded recovery, and repeated failures return the strategy to Astra for another independent review.

text.tspan: Each agent has a separate role: Astra reviews strategy without editing, while Sol performs the autorun work.
The project manifest defines success, and soft review gates never reset the original hard ceilings.
